items.summary: Synthpop wizard Vince Clarke was responsible for some of the most indelible jams of the early '80s, but he took a while to find a stable artistic partnership. Clarke wrote most of the song's on Depeche Mode's classic 1981 debut Speak & Spell , then left the group. He formed Yazoo with Alison Moyet, but they only released two (excellent) LPs before breaking up. Finally, Clarke looked for collaborators by placing an ad in NME , and that's how he found the singer Andy Bell. They became the duo Erasure, and they've been working together ever since. items.title: The Olivia Tremor Control – “Timewaster”
items.summary: We're nearing the release of one last opus from Athens, Georgia's Olivia Tremor Control, the psych-pop cult favorites and a core fixture of the Elephant 6 collective. Bill Doss and Will Cullen Hart, the Lennon and McCartney of the OTC, are no longer with us. But before they died — Doss in 2012 , Hart in 2024 — they began work on a double album called The Same Place .
